notes.text:
Power tree GUI task:
- Built power_tree project directly in /home/cua/kicad_project with 4 regulators, 11 capacitors, +12V and plain GND symbols, and four local output labels.
- Available module library entry: Converter_DCDC:OKI-78SR-3.3_1.5-W36-C. Set displayed Value to requested OKI-78SR-3.3/1.5-W36E-C. Pins 1 IN, 2 GND, 3 OUT.
- Fixed Regulator_Linear:LT1761-2.5, LT1761-1.8, LT1761-1.2 exist; pins 1 VIN, 2 GND, 3 shutdown, 4 BYP, 5 VOUT. Connect shutdown to VIN for always-on operation.
- Ctrl+D preserves values and orientation and allocates next reference. Place bypass capacitors first to maintain design numbering.
- GUI wire endpoints and junctions visually match intended nine nets. ERC reported only undriven external +12V and GND supply pins. No power flags added.
- File > Export > Netlist opens KiCad tab. Export (650,774), verify power_tree.net and kicad_project folder, Save (757,913). Export closes both dialogs and marks schematic modified: save again with Ctrl+S.
- Scroll zoom initially overshot; home then two f1 presses restored useful scale. Lowercase key names work.
- Prior evaluator scores: infrared 0.33, dual rail 0.00, empty netlist 1.00. Empty netlist score supports that export workflow; it does not validate earlier populated circuits. Current circuit has no score yet; connectivity correctness remains based on GUI review and ERC.
- Final step 111 confirms clean power_tree title and status File '/home/cua/kicad_project/power_tree.kicad_sch' saved. Netlist export was completed at step 109; final Ctrl+S at step 110.
